entries.subject: You reached {realm}!
entries.body: Lu told me. I cried a little. Eat properly. I sent rice balls.

entries.subject: About that wall
entries.body: You've been stuck at {realm} for a while. Open the Breakthrough panel and read each requirement. Every one has a fix.

entries.subject: Welcome to Jade River
entries.body: A small gift for the road.

entries.subject: I drew you!
entries.body: This is you punching a crab. The crab is losing.

entries.subject: Items you couldn't carry
entries.body: These were found where you left them.

entries.subject: A second path
entries.body: One cultivator cannot walk every road.

entries.subject: Your lot: {item}
entries.body: The hammer fell in your favour. Your lot is enclosed, with the Pavilion's compliments.
